visual_review: Reviewed 48px light/dark: tall cab, chimney and rounded nose on one continuous body; three equal wheels share the frame line; clean joins.
omissions: Big driving wheel drawn same size as the small wheels (three distinct wheel sizes cannot keep 8-unit clearance in 40 units); cowcatcher, steam dome and wheel hubs dropped; cab window reduced to a dot.
lucide_reference: train-front (rounded corners, straight runs); no side-view locomotive locally
